name: character-studio
description: Build low-poly humanoids in editable body, outfit, footwear, face and hair stages, then test animation and GLB delivery in Blender.

interface.shortDescription: Create stylized low-poly characters in Blender
interface.longDescription: Defaults to staged low-poly humanoid construction from a reference, with a bald T-pose body, clothing, boots, face and hair checkpoints, selective part edits and verified animation. Includes optional robot and fox/dog/cat routes, Blender effects, local reference comparisons and documented security protections.
defaultPrompt: Use Character Studio to design and build a stylized low-poly 3D character in Blender.
